properties.note: C1 is answered: both accepted requirements now have a capability, and they are built on branch feat/web-of-rules (merge pending). C2 is answered in reflow2: a number is held as a quantity (a Constraint with a limit), and flo2-calc 0.13.0 binds an input to it. C3 is answered: whoever registers a record passes its inputs, and an edge per input keeps what was used. C5 is answered in part: a drawing registered with its model as an input reads owed when the model's checksum moves, and the redo list reaches models and drawings. NOT closed in practice: on flo2.io nothing is registered with its inputs until flo2's door passes them, and until a reflow2 release carrying this reaches flo2.io. Grouping by trade is also still open. The class (C6, an accepted requirement nobody schedules) is not answered by this change.
